name: infantry_list_sessions
description: List the SESSIONS (running or past agent runs, not saved profiles) the Infantry AI daemon knows: id, agentId, role, provider, model, projectId, status.

limit.description: At most this many sessions (live ones first, then the most recent). Default: setting limits.tools.listLimit.

projectId.description: Only this project's sessions. Omitted: a session caller's own project (everyone else: all). "all" lists every project (pm / owner callers only).

name: infantry_get_session
description: One session's status and the last lines of its transcript (from the daemon's replay buffer, bounded).

sessionId.description: Session id, or a unique prefix of one.

lines.description: How many trailing transcript lines to return (default: setting limits.tools.sessionTailLines, 5).

brief.description: Omit the transcript: return only state, live state, last action and last output/event times.

name: infantry_spawn
description: Spawn an Infantry AI session for a role and/or an agent profile, optionally sending it a first task, OUTSIDE the board: it runs in the project folder and leaves every ticket untouched. Never use it for ticket work: start ticket work with infantry_ticket_start (or pass ticketId here, which does the same).

role.description: Role to spawn (role-first, like the `new` frame).

agentId.description: Agent profile id; with role, it must be that profile's role.

projectId.description: Project the session belongs to (default: the caller's project).

provider.description: Harness (provider id) the session runs: see infantry_list_harnesses. Omitted = the daemon's default.

model.description: Model id of that harness (infantry_list_harnesses lists them).

effort.description: Reasoning effort for the session: low, medium, high, xhigh or max (off = the harness default).

task.description: Optional first prompt for the new session.

ticketId.description: Start this board ticket instead (full id or its 8-char suffix), exactly as infantry_ticket_start.

name: infantry_prompt
description: Send a prompt to an existing session (id or unique prefix). Slash commands are refused.

sessionId.description: Session id, or a unique prefix of one.

prompt.description: The words to send to the agent.

name: infantry_kill
description: Kill a session (id or unique prefix). A pm (or the owner) may kill any session in its own project; other roles only sessions they spawned.

sessionId.description: Session id, or a unique prefix of one.

force.description: Kill the process tree at once instead of after the grace period.

name: infantry_list_harnesses
description: List the harnesses an agent can run on: each harness id (a provider value) with its models, which one is the default, and whether its CLI is available.

name: infantry_usage
description: Read plan usage per meter: percent of the plan window used (the highest window), when it resets, points ahead/under an even burn, and how many ticket workers the pacing rule allows versus how many run. Text summary; pass json=true to append the full JSON report.

json.description: Append the full JSON report after the text summary (default false).

name: infantry_usage_override
description: Override the usage pacing allowance for a meter (owner and pm roles; setting usage.overrideRoles). value = a ticket-worker count, 'none' (no limit) or 'clear' (the pacing rule decides again). The override lasts hours hours, default until the meter resets (else 2h).

meter.description: The meter to override (claude, codex, opencode-go, ...)

hours.description: How long the override lasts, in hours (default: until the meter resets)

name: infantry_pace
description: Read the pacing history the daemon recorded from the plan meters: per provider window the percent used, the pace delta, the projected landing at reset, the momentum and the forecast to reset.

sinceHours.description: Only points from the last N hours (default: all)

samples.description: "true" adds the newest raw samples per series; default off

name: infantry_message
description: Send a message (COMMS mail) to another agent by session id, agent id or role, or to the owner. Replies go in the same thread with replyTo. Returns the message id.

to.description: Recipient: session id, agent profile id, role id, or owner.

replyTo.description: Message id (or 8-char prefix) this answers; keeps the thread.

allowCrossProject.description: Allow a recipient in another project.

kind.description: Optional notice kind (e.g. build.success, build.failed, ticket.done.ping). With a kind, the setting notify.wake.kinds decides: a kind that wakes is mailed, any other lands in the recipient's attention inbox with no mail and no turn.

key.description: Optional dedupe key for kind (a build run id, a ticket id): the same kind+key wakes a recipient at most once, across mails and ticket comments.

name: infantry_inbox
description: List the messages addressed to you (id, from, subject, state). unreadOnly limits it to the ones you have not read.

limit.description: At most this many, newest first.

name: infantry_read
description: Read one message in full by id (8-char prefix works) and mark it read.

name: infantry_session_remove
description: Remove a session from the list. A live session is refused unless force=true, which ends it first. Only the pm or the owner (own project), or the session's spawner, may remove one. An id no session matches is already gone: OK with outcome already-removed.

force.description: End a live session and remove it in one step.

name: infantry_agent_list
description: Every agent the daemon's agent registry holds (built-in roles and plugin-contributed agents): id, name, whether it is enabled, who contributed it.

name: infantry_agent_get
description: One agent of the registry in full: its definition (instructions or role, default harness/model/context limit, tools, schedule, ui hints), contributor and enabled state.

name: infantry_agent_enable
description: Re-enable a disabled agent (non-agent caller only).

name: infantry_agent_disable
description: Disable an agent: new sessions of it are refused, running ones carry on (non-agent caller only).

name: infantry_waiting
description: Flag YOUR session 'active but waiting' (on) or not waiting (off). Use it when your turn is about to end while you wait on a process (a build, a long test, a background job): your card shows 'waiting' with your reason instead of looking idle, and no watcher nudges you. It turns itself off when your next turn starts, and expires after untilMinutes (+ a grace). get = read the flag. The CLI does the same without MCP: infantry waiting on --reason "..." [--minutes N] | off.

reason.description: mode on: what you are waiting for (required).

untilMinutes.description: mode on: how long you expect to wait (omit = the default setting).

name: infantry_pod_state
description: Summary of the pod: saved PROFILES (templates, not running) grouped by role under `agents`, SESSIONS by status; optionally one project's `roster` (its live AGENTS, BUSY/IDLE/OFFLINE: who can be assigned work) and one pod's node state.

projectId.description: Include this project's live roster (running agents, not profiles). Default: the caller's own project; "all" (pm / owner callers only) covers every project.

podId.description: Include this pod's state and nodes.

name: infantry_session_restart
description: Restart a session: the same session, a fresh conversation (its next turn is a first turn). A running turn is refused unless force=true, which stops it first.

sessionId.description: Session id, or a unique prefix of one.

name: infantry_capability_list
description: List the capabilities the loaded plugins offer (id, module, runs, action, available). Call one by its dotted id from a script: ih.call("id", {...}).

name: infantry_attention_raise
description: Raise an item on the owner's attention list (kind, outcome, detail; optional ticketId / sessionId). For scripts and agents that report something the owner must see.

kind.description: An attention kind, e.g. session_resumed, stalled, unreported.

outcome.description: A short machine word for what happened, e.g. resumed_after_restart.

detail.description: What the owner reads, at most 2000 characters.

name: infantry_prompt_answer
description: Answer a question (or tool approval) an agent is BLOCKED on: the answer returns to its blocked tool call. When questions.route sends a session's questions to you (the pm), the wake line names the promptId. promptId + answers (option labels; several only for a multi-select question) and/or otherText; for a tool approval pass decision (allow_once, allow_session, allow_always, deny). escalate=true hands a pm-then-owner question to the owner instead. With no promptId it lists the open prompts. Only the owner or the pm; the CLI does the same: infantry prompt answer <promptId> --answer <label> [--text <t>] | --escalate.

otherText.description: Your own words (when the question allows it).

decision.description: Tool approvals only: allow_once, allow_session, allow_always, deny.

escalate.description: Hand a pm-then-owner question to the owner.

name: infantry_ask
description: Ask the owner ONE decision: the question in plain words, 2 to 8 answer options (2 to 4 reads best), the recommended option and a one-line reason. It shows as a decision mail at the top of the owner's Mail inbox (desktop and phone) with one button per option and a free-text answer. Non-blocking: carry on; the owner's answer arrives in your session as mail on thread question:<id>. Rate-limited per agent (3 open, 6 an hour).

question.description: The decision, in plain words (max 2000 characters).

options.description: 2 to 8 answers: plain labels, or {label, description}.

recommended.description: The label of the option you recommend.

reason.description: Why you recommend it, one line (max 200 characters).

defaultAfterMin.description: Optional: auto-pick the recommended option after this many minutes (1-1440) if the owner has not answered.

name: infantry_notify
description: Post a notice to the owner (in-app toast and OS notification) through the notification hub. For scripts and agents reporting something the owner must see now.

level.description: info | success (or milestone) | warning | error | urgent

sound.description: Accepted for script compatibility; the presenter picks the sound.

name: infantry_session_act
description: Act on another session (pm, owner or script only): queue_add holds text as the session's next turn (a turn now when it is at rest); deliver_urgent puts it into the running turn when the harness takes input mid-turn.

name: infantry_session_read
description: One session's recent transcript as JSON: {sessionId, state, turn, lastAction, lastError, olderLeftOut, frames:[{seq, type, text}]} (from the daemon's replay buffer, bounded). Same project only.

sessionId.description: Session id, or a unique prefix of one.

sinceSeq.description: Only frames after this sequence number.

name: infantry_progress
description: Report progress on your session's card: percent, a label, a plan of steps and the step done, a count (done/total), or state done/failed; clear=true removes the line. A report keeps what it does not name.

steps.description: Declare a plan (starts a fresh line).

step.description: That step completed (a name from the plan, else the next one).

sessionId.description: Owner only (a script reports for its hook's session through this).

name: infantry_event_emit
description: Emit a named event on the daemon bus: script hooks subscribed to that name fire. The payload gets the caller's projectId (only that project's hooks see it). Daemon event families (session., ticket., mail., run., mcp., modules., timer) are reserved.

name.description: Event name: lower-case words joined by '.', '_' or '-' (at most 64 chars).

name: infantry_capability_call
description: Call a plugin capability (an id from infantry_capability_list, runs: daemon) and return its answer. A dotted name in a script (ih["news.headlines"]{}) runs this tool.

target.description: Where it runs: daemon (the default and the only host served here).
